definitions.explanation: One of the most common Japanese surnames.

examples.japanese: {鈴木|すずき}⟦{夫妻|ふさい}→夫妻：00047_fusai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
{鈴木|すずき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{二番目|にばんめ}→二番目：30362_nibanme⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧{名字|みょうじ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Suzuki is the second most common surname in Japan.

notes:
{鈴木|すずき} is the second most common Japanese surname, after ⟦{佐藤|さとう}→佐藤：27597_satou⟧.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{鈴|すず}→鈴：03890_suzu⟧: bell
- ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧: tree
- The name is believed to originate from Shinto practices involving sacred wands ({神楽鈴|かぐらすず}) and is closely associated with the Kumano region in ⟦{和歌山県|わかやまけん}→和歌山県：29006_wakayamaken⟧.

COMMON JAPANESE SURNAMES:
- ⟦{佐藤|さとう}→佐藤：27597_satou⟧: Satō (most common)
- {鈴木|すずき}: Suzuki (second)
- {高橋|たかはし}: Takahashi
- ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧: Tanaka
- ⟦{山田|やまだ}→山田：09529_yamada⟧: Yamada

USAGE:
Also the name of the famous automotive and motorcycle manufacturer スズキ ({鈴木|すずき}), known worldwide.
